verdict.rationale: Evidence shows support for multiple architectures (chat, MoE-style qwen3.5-a3b, multimodal per comm-18, image generation per docs-22) and a broad model library reference (llms.txt probe-1), but there is no explicit mention of embedding-model support or a documented count of 'hundreds' of architectures, and some community comments note gaps versus llama.cpp in configurability and hardware support (comm-7, comm-11, comm-13). missing for 10: explicit embedding-model support, documented breadth/count of supported architectures, independent verification of MoE/multimodal coverage across the full model catalog.
